protocol: Direct comparison of initial-run outputs to the human-authored AMI abstract, four grouped final-decision sentences and one action sentence. This is a transparent reference-coverage check, not an independent human factuality rating or a hosted judge. No 60–75% overall coverage score is asserted.
reference_final_decisions: It was decided that the group will produce one product design instead of creating alternate designs in an attempt to accomodate different users' preferences.
The marketing will be focused towards a young, business-class buyer.
The remote will feature Video Plus capabilities and a seashell-like shape to accomodate the LCD display and the flip screen.
The remote will be bundled with a docking station to recharge the remote's batteries and a user-friendly instruction manual, and multiple casings will be made available.
reference_action_items: The Marketing Expert will research consumers' opinions on instruction manuals.

runs.scope_note: Stock output contains a TV-only/no-teletext scope statement supported by the transcript and reference abstract, but it does not recover any of the four annotated final decision groups.
Paiton output retains eight discussion-topic labels and no decision/action claims. This is a topic-focused partial draft.

limitations: The output outlines opening/middle discussion but misses the reference final decisions: one design, young business-class market, Video Plus/seashell shape, and docking/manual/casing choices.
The marketing task to research consumers' opinions on instruction manuals is missing.
The reference decision groups are not an exhaustive list of every supported statement. A supported scope fact is not counted as recovery of an unrelated reference decision.
Do not mistake source-reference validation for semantic factuality or high recall. Missing items are permitted by the partial-draft scope and remain visible in the full transcript.
The synthetic fixture separately verifies extraction of an explicit USB-C decision, Morgan/Tuesday action and undecided launch while rejecting injected fictional commitments.
